notes: Fixes Dusklight's audio-only black screen on Raspberry Pi 4 and Pi 5 by compiling OpenGL ES pipelines on the render worker that owns the graphics context.
Tunes Dusklight for Raspberry Pi with OpenGL ES, a 30 FPS target, and model-specific internal resolution defaults for Pi 4 and Pi 5.
Improves Twilight Princess and legacy NKit detection, including reliable engine validation and prioritizing likely ROM matches before unrelated GameCube images.
Preserves the Game Center library cache during unchanged RetroNAS reconnects so opening Game Center does not trigger another full scan.
